Report an issue"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What is Deeptop"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**Deeptop** brings the agent capabilities of DSH into a native desktop environment built for deep wo"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"rk: organize tasks as sessions, ground them in workspaces, and handle tool calls, approvals, follow-"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"up questions and diagnostics right where the work happens."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"It does not put `dsh web` inside a desktop window, nor does it reimplement an agent in the app. DSH "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"remains the source of truth for Agent, Session, Tool, Model, Workspace, Skill, Goal, Provider, persi"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"stence and event semantics; Tauri/Rust owns native windows, process supervision and system capabilit"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ies, and React renders a clear, actionable desktop interface."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> **Desktop first.** Directory picking, file saving and log export go through native Tauri/Bridge ca"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"pabilities; the interface never relies on browser downloads, browser dialogs or internal URLs to per"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"form system operations."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Core experience"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Capability | What you can do |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| **Workspaces & sessions** | Attach working directories with the native directory picker; create, s"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"earch, fork, archive, restore and export sessions. |
| **Session tray** | See unread and recent sess"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ions in the system tray, reach the rest through “More”, and restore the window straight into a conve"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"rsation; the Windows tray popup has a fixed width and follows Deeptop's light/dark and custom themes"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"tion; the Windows tray popup has a fixed width and follows Deeptop's light/dark and custom themes. |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| **Interactive pets** | Enable an isolated transparent always-on-top pet window that can be dragged"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" across applications and monitors and reacts to taps, long presses and task activity. A shared care "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"layer persists satiety, mood and affection, supports feeding, petting and play, survives skin change"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"s and can be paused independently. The Deeptop activity card can handle a session or switch to the c"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"are panel. Script-free `.deeptop-pet` packs remain separate from care rules and the DSH Bridge, and "},{"id":"p12s6","text":"the master switch destroys the complete pet window. The complete feature can also be removed from so"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"urce with `npm run pets:remove`. |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| **Continuous conversations** | Stream answers and reasoning as they generate; attach images; queue"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" or steer follow-up prompts while a task is running. |
